+"""Merge validity keys."""
+
+def merged_netuids(validity_map: dict) -> list[int]:
+    keys = list(validity_map.keys())
+    out = []
+    for i, k in enumerate(keys):
+        for j, k2 in enumerate(keys):
+            if i == j and int(k2):
+                out.append(int(k2))
+    return sorted(out)
